dc_title_s: Countywide Aerial Imagery Mosaic for Dunn County, WI 2017
dc_description_s: This metadata describes the digital ortho imagery covering a selected area of Dunn County, WI. This 1 inch = 100 foot scale imagery is comprised of 3-band (RGB) color orthoimagery with a GSD (Ground Sample Distance) of 0.5'. Imagery was collected with Leica ADS100 digital sensor and processed with Leica XPro software. Imagery is in Latitude/Longitude coordinates and projected in the Wisconsin Coordinate Reference System (WISCRS), Dunn County Zone using the Transverse Mercator map projection parameters. Horizontal datum is NAD83(1991). Vertical datum is NAVD88(Geoid12B). The four ADS100 bands record data in the following manner: Band 1 (blue)= 435-495nm; Band 2 (green)= 525-584nm; Band 3 (red)= 619-651nm; Band 4 (Near InfraRed (NIR))= 808-882nm. The NIR band is not included as part of this data set. Because the ADS100 is a pushbroom type scanner, objects in motion (ground vehicles, aircraft, etc.) in the direction of flight (the sensor direction of motion) will reside in the scan line field of view longer and appear stretched, where-as, objects in motion in an opposite direction to aircraft direction will reside less time in the scan line and appear compressed. This is an inherent feature of pushbroom type scanning systems where objects in motion pass within the field of view of a sensor platform that is also in motion.
